plan_review.summary: Separate-model plan review requested two concrete changes: thread per-instance dialogue override through both MainGameScene conversation paths, and add explicit elite appearance resolution coverage instead of assuming the appearance key already yields elite art.

rounds.notes: One concern: getFloor2FamilyFallbackArchetype returns nonElite[0] vs canonical fallback in GENERATED_BRIEF_BY_APPEARANCE_KEY. Analysis: all non-elite archetypes within each family share the same brief id in the mapping so visual outcome is identical. No code change required.
